verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like Wrike, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents an MCP connection, a REST API with OAuth, a Batch API, desktop and mobile apps, and no-code automations, but no official command-line tool. API endpoints are developer building blocks and MCP is a different capability, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
